job.job_description:
Job Summary:

- Design, develop, and maintain web applications using Python for backend and Angular for frontend.
- Build and optimize cloud-based solutions leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
- Ensure code quality, performance, and scalability of applications.
- Implement best practices for security, reliability, and maintainability in cloud environments.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues across the full application stack.
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to team knowledge sharing.
- Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies relevant to Python, Angular, and GCP.
